# About Us

# About Aqua Ventana

LA VENTANA, BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR, MEXICO

We are Baja's boutique adventure resort, a unique waterfront destination for your next vacation. Let us pamper you with our great location, deluxe accommodations, and multitude of amenities. You can enjoy tasty food and drinks in our onsite restaurant and beach bar, get a massage or spa treatment, or visit our sports center for pro instruction and rentals in wind sports, foiling, and mountain biking- or just cruise on the bay on our paddle boards or cruise town on bikes! We offer many unique and well-appointed lodging options throughout our beachfront property and our attentive staff is ready to help you make great vacations and memories.

![Aerial view of a coastal town with sandy beaches and scattered residential buildings.](https://media-bridge.thinkreservations.com/media-library/hotels/284445263806/90b4dc9a-236e-4375-ba47-23a6d21b07e3/aquav-A7.jpg)

## Our Location

La Ventana is a small town on the shore of La Ventana Bay south of La Paz on the eastern side of the Baja California peninsula in the Mexican state of Baja California Sur. La Ventana Bay (Bahia de la Ventana) is known for consistent north winds that blow from November to April, and the incredible sea life for ocean seafaris and fishing as well.

## Popular FAQs

**What does the room price include?**

Our prices cover lodging, daily maid service ( on request) , wifi, and use of sports gear which includes kayaks, SUP (stand up paddle) gear, cruiser bikes, and snorkeling gear. Meals and drinks/beverages are charged to your room and settled at check out. Mountain bike and water sports gear rental and instruction is available on-site. Mexican VAT and hotel tax are additional.

**Our Booking/Cancellation Policy**

Confirmation of your reservation requires a deposit payment of 50% of your pretax lodging or package price. The balance plus taxes, and any incidental expenses from the restaurants or sports center will be due at check-out from the resort. Reservation modifications must be made 72 hours prior to check in, and subject to availability. Any modifications made after 72 hours will be charged for the original reservation dates, and any additional reservation changes.Cancellation Policy: We offer a full refund of your deposit payment if canceled 60 or more days before your check-in date. Reservation cancellations between 59-30 before check-in will be refunded 50% of your deposit payment. Cancellations fewer than 30 days before check-in will not be refunded any deposit payment.

**How should I secure my valuables?**

Each room has its own locking safe.

**Does each room have a private bathroom?**

All of our rooms have private in-suite bathrooms, mini fridge, a locking safe for your valuables, and a large dispenser of purified water. All power outlets are same as US, no need for electrical adapters.

**Do you rent gear to non-guests?**

A common question is "do you rent Windsurfing, SUP, Kayaks and Mountain Bikes to walk-ins (people who are not staying at the resort)?" Yes, but our guests do have priority. That said we have plenty of gear and almost always have been able to take care of our guests and also walk in customers for gear.

**How do I set up sports gear rental and instruction?**

Contact us for all things sports related; Windsurf, wing foil, kite boarding, and mountain bike instruction and gear rental. It's often quite busy during the high season so we recommend that you arrange your lessons before arriving. Wind sport gear rental is available too, but you will need to demonstrate proficiency or have a an IKO card. Check ahead!

![A seaside restaurant table set with various dishes and drinks, overlooking the ocean.](https://media-bridge.thinkreservations.com/media-library/hotels/284445263806/933129a9-5c81-4fdb-b9d7-5f36c3ca0d30/aquav-C1.jpg)

### Restaurant Hours

Coyas is open during our high season dates (Nov 1-Apr 31) from 7am-3pm daily, and **closed during our low season**. Our Aqua beach bar is open year round, and offers bar food and drinks, 1pm-9pm daily ( Nov 1-April 30) and 12-8 daily during our low season (May 1-Oct 31).

![A serene beach scene at sunset with palm trees and calm waters.](https://media-bridge.thinkreservations.com/media-library/hotels/284445263806/8f9c5ad4-daaf-4a0d-a011-02fdfb7c16b1/B59C8FAE-7D21-4B5E-A3E0-51FB28E950FD.jpg)

### What Our Guests Say

OUR REVIEWS

We always stay at Aqua Ventana and we LOVE it! We go to LV several times throughout the winter to get our wind fix and we always land at Aqua. The staff is amazing, beach access is as good as it gets and the rooms are great - clean, comfortable and spacious. The location is perfect - both for launching kites and for walking or biking easily to nearby bars and restaurants. The place feels like a home away from home and we can immediately feel like we are on vacation as soon as we arrive.

— Pam

We were so incredibly happy with your place. Nothing could've been better. The location was perfect for the event, the place is beautiful and we cannot say enough about the food. Thank you so much for having us. We now know where we'll be staying when we come to La Ventana again. Everyone was very friendly and we look forward to meeting you next time we're there.

— Marcella

If you want to go where life's warm and slow, go to Baja. If you want fantastic wind for kiting, go to La Ventana. If you want the place to relax well, eat amazing food, lounge in the shade and watch the kite/air show or sit in the hot tub after you get out of the water, go to Aqua Ventana. You can feel the care and hard work that Esteban and crew have put into creating this place over the years. You'll not find another like it anywhere.

— Christopher

My wife and I spent a week at Aqua Ventana between Christmas and New Year's. It's a beautiful place with all the comforts of home, but none of the annoyances, and plenty of wind. Steve keeps about several quivers of sails rigged and in a bodega on the beach, right next to a big rack of about 35 boards in any range you could ever need. Sailing literally out of his backyard/beach - that's the way a vacation should be! On the calm days, my wife took beginner lessons and I went exploring in one of the kayaks. Overall, it was a great vacation!

— David
